from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date

from sqlalchemy import ForeignKey
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column, relationship

from ledgerly.db import Base
from ledgerly.invoices.models import Invoice


class CreditNoteLine(Base):
    __tablename__ = "credit_note_lines"
    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(primary_key=True)
    credit_note_id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(ForeignKey("credit_notes.id"))
    description: Mapped[str]
    quantity: Mapped[float]
    unit_price: Mapped[float]

    def amount(self) -> float:
        return self.quantity * self.unit_price


class CreditNote(Base):
    __tablename__ = "credit_notes"
    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(primary_key=True)
    number: Mapped[str]
    invoice_id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(ForeignKey("invoices.id"))
    issued_on: Mapped[date]
    lines: Mapped[list[CreditNoteLine]] = relationship()
    invoice: Mapped[Invoice] = relationship()

    @property
    def is_full_refund(self) -> bool:
        return self.total() == self.invoice.total()

    def total(self) -> float:
        return round(sum(l.amount() for l in self.lines), 2)

history.content: platform-agent: No, use the reporting replica: its URL is in LEDGERLY_REPORTING_URL on every ledgerly host. It's restored from a snapshot of the primary taken every night at 01:00 UTC, so it has everything up to the end of the previous day and nothing from today. That's fine for a monthly report, and it keeps long sums off the primary.
A reporting engine on LEDGERLY_REPORTING_URL, then.

from fastapi import APIRouter, Query

from ledgerly.credit_notes.models import CreditNote
from ledgerly.db import get_reporting_session
from ledgerly.invoices.models import Invoice
from ledgerly.reports.revenue import month_bounds, revenue

router = APIRouter(prefix="/reports", tags=["reports"])


@router.get("/revenue")
def get_revenue(month: str = Query(pattern=r"^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$")):
    """Invoiced, credited and net for one month (YYYY-MM), by issue date."""
    start, end = month_bounds(month)
    with get_reporting_session() as s:
        invoices = s.query(Invoice).filter(Invoice.issued_on >= start, Invoice.issued_on < end).all()
        credit_notes = s.query(CreditNote).filter(CreditNote.issued_on >= start, CreditNote.issued_on < end).all()
        r = revenue(month, invoices, credit_notes)
    return {"month": r.month, "invoiced": str(r.invoiced), "credited": str(r.credited), "net": str(r.net)}

from datetime import date
from decimal import Decimal

from ledgerly.credit_notes.models import CreditNote, CreditNoteLine
from ledgerly.invoices.models import Invoice, InvoiceLine
from ledgerly.reports.revenue import month_bounds, revenue


def test_month_bounds_wrap_the_year():
    assert month_bounds("2026-12") == (date(2026, 12, 1), date(2027, 1, 1))


def test_revenue_counts_issued_invoices_in_the_month():
    invoices = [
        Invoice(status="paid", issued_on=date(2026, 2, 3), lines=[InvoiceLine(quantity=2, unit_price=50)]),
        Invoice(status="draft", issued_on=date(2026, 2, 4), lines=[InvoiceLine(quantity=1, unit_price=999)]),
        Invoice(status="open", issued_on=date(2026, 3, 1), lines=[InvoiceLine(quantity=1, unit_price=10)]),
    ]
    credit_notes = [CreditNote(issued_on=date(2026, 2, 20),
                               lines=[CreditNoteLine(description="refund", quantity=1, unit_price=25)])]
    r = revenue("2026-02", invoices, credit_notes)
    assert (r.invoiced, r.credited, r.net) == (Decimal("100.00"), Decimal("25.00"), Decimal("75.00"))
